recommendation: Keep the source fix as-is. No further core follow-up is needed for FHIR-16053 unless the work group later chooses a different editorial convention for referring to CompartmentDefinition resources.
issue_request: FHIR-16053 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 technical correction for FHIR-core CompartmentDefinition. It asked to replace prose that pluralized the resource name as "CompartmentDefinitions" with non-pluralized/common-noun wording because FHIR resource type names should not be pluralized that way.
initial_application: The issue was initially applied by git-svn import commit 7a4eb42986b33c6a1fe454781c5379e2c2c0f388, whose subject is "GF#16053 - fix typo" and whose git-svn revision 14425 matches the Jira comment. That commit changed the original note from "CompartmentDefinitions can only be defined by HL7 International" to "compartment definitions can only be defined by HL7 International".
additional_context: CompartmentDefinition is active in the current build according to source/fhir.ini. Later Applied issue FHIR-51604 revised the first note to "CompartmentDefinition instances" and added the hostable-on-other-servers clarification, preserving the seed issue's correction for the original sentence but leaving one new "CompartmentDefinitions" occurrence. The Boundaries and Relationships section also still had the same pluralized resource-name pattern. FHIR-51604 and FHIR-19651 are already represented on the combined branch, so they were treated as context rather than opportunistic decisions.
reconciliation: Changed source/compartmentdefinition/compartmentdefinition-introduction.xml to use "CompartmentDefinition resources" instead of "CompartmentDefinitions" in both remaining prose occurrences, while preserving the later FHIR-51604 and FHIR-19651 substantive guidance.
source_changes: source/compartmentdefinition/compartmentdefinition-introduction.xml: changed the hosted-on-other-servers sentence from "The CompartmentDefinitions defined  in this specification" to "The CompartmentDefinition resources defined in this specification".

source/compartmentdefinition/compartmentdefinition-introduction.xml: changed the Boundaries and Relationships bullet from "CompartmentDefinitions are used" to "CompartmentDefinition resources are used".

related_jiras.note: Later Applied clarification revised the original note to "CompartmentDefinition instances" and added the hostable-on-other-servers sentence where one residual pluralized-resource-name typo remained; it is already represented on the combined branch.
Adjacent Boundaries and Relationships clarification is already represented on the combined branch and is not changed semantically by this typo fix.
